messages:
maria: WIP upload: ran a focused bakeoff for ORION-13B comparing baseline fp32 vs INT8 (GPTQ), AWQ, and an FP8-on-KV config. gist + raw csv in the drive. TL;DR: FP8-KV gives the best memory reduction and slightly better p50 vs INT8, with ~0.8% QA EM delta. Details below and a quick table.

ken: nice. can you paste the key numbers here? interested in p95 tails and mem.

josh: pasted the condensed table from the run (single-shot chat QA eval, 1k examples). happy to share raw traces if anyone needs em.

```
Model         Mem(GB)  p50(ms) p95(ms) QA_EM_delta
baseline_fp32 14.2     62      145     0.0%
INT8-GPTQ     10.1     68      170     -1.9%
AWQ           9.6      75      185     -2.6%
FP8-KV        8.4      58      160     -0.8%
FP8-KV+INT8   7.9      61      165     -1.1%
```

anita: low mem and lower p50 for FP8-KV is promising. what's the coldstart behavior / warmup jitter? any spikes?

maria: good question. we saw some cold tail spikes when prefill < 8 tokens. warmup at first few requests caused p95 to jump ~40% for FP8-KV on an otherwise idle instance. after a tiny periodic prefill (prefill_threshold=16) the jitter subsided.

josh: command we used so ppl can reproduce:
```
./bench --model orion-13b --quant fp8-kv --kv-only --batch 1 --prefill 32 --prefill_threshold 16 --trace-level perf --out csv
```

ken: did you run hybrid (FP8 for KV + INT8 weights) vs pure FP8-KV? any accuracy delta synergy?

maria: yes - FP8-KV + INT8 weights (FP8-KV+INT8) saved a bit more memory (7.9GB) but QA delta moved to ~1.1%. judged acceptable for low-priority routes. pure FP8-KV is best perf/accuracy tradeoff for hot paths.

anita: what about beam/longer context? our customers push 4k+ contexts. did you check memory scaling vs seq-len?

josh: scaled to 4k. FP8-KV gave ~18% additional free headroom vs INT8 at 4k because KV storage compresses better with fp8 representation. tail latency still grows linearly with seq but prefilling strategy helped.

ci-bot: shadow-run-orion13b-quant (sha: 0a1b2c) completed: 64/64 checks OK. artifacts -> s3://redwood-dev/ci/orion13b-quant/1719210000/

maria: notes/recs:
- For hosted hot-paths: enable FP8-KV with prefill_threshold=16, kv-cache eviction check every 30s.
- For dedicated low-latency routes: consider FP8-KV+INT8 if you need extra headroom but accept ~1% QA delta.
- Avoid aggressive prefill<8; causes coldstart p95 spikes.
- Run a short shadow on Dedicated 4xA100 and confirm multi-tenant interference before rollout.

ken: can you add a short perf dashboard (p50/p95/mem) to the console so we can watch canary?

maria: will do, adding charts and a canary flag. planning a two-week shadow with fallbacks to INT8.

deploy-bot: Canary for orion-13b-quant scheduled on dedicated-tier-2 at 2024-05-14T03:00Z :rocket:

anita: awesome, please also tag the eval set and seed used so we can repro quality checks.

maria: done — eval_set: qa-mini-1k-v2, seed: 42, repo: git@github.com:redwood-inference/evals.git#orion-13b-quant-bake. raw CSV + traces in the drive.

josh: thanks — i'll kick off the Dedicated 4xA100 shadow tonight and post results. :thumbsup:
